title: MOBY availability forecast parameters
description: The fitted queue model of the availability forecast, written by analysis/fit.py. Rates are per minute. A time bin is the local hour (0 to 23) on Monday to Friday, and the local hour plus 24 on Saturday and Sunday.

format.description: The version of this format. A reader must refuse a format that it does not know.

model.description: The version of the model that made the parameters.

fitted_at.description: The time of the fit, in RFC 3339 format, UTC.

history.description: The data that the fit used.

start.description: The first accepted poll, in RFC 3339 format, UTC.

end.description: The last accepted poll, in RFC 3339 format, UTC.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the time bins.

mode.description: How bikes leave a reach. pool: at the departure rate of the reach while it has at least one bike. bike: each bike at the departure rate, so n bikes leave at n times the rate.

rules.description: The rules that the fit used to find rentable bikes in bays. The service must apply the same rules to the count at the origin.

vehicle_type_id.description: The vehicle type whose rules give the parking bays.

min_range_m.description: The minimum range of a rentable bike, in metres.

bay_distance_m.description: A bike is in the nearest bay within this distance, in metres.

move_m.description: A step longer than this between two positions of a bike in the feed is a move, in metres.

stale_max_min.description: A bike whose stay began with a ride, or with a move that does not correct a stale position, is suspect for this time, in minutes.

hysteresis_polls.description: A bike must be in a bay, or out of it, for this many accepted polls in sequence before the change counts.

reach_m.description: The walking distance of the reach of a place, in metres.

detour_factor.description: For a point that is not a place, the estimated walking distance to a bay is the straight-line distance times this factor.

suspect_share.description: The probability that a suspect bike at the origin is rentable.

min_states.description: For n bikes at the origin (certain and suspect), the chain has max(min_states, 2n + 10) states: counts 0 to states - 1. Births stop at the largest count, and a count above it is put in it.

arrival.description: Arrivals of rentable bikes. The exposure is the minutes in each bin.

departure.description: Departures of rentable bikes. The exposure is the minutes with at least one rentable bike in the bay (mode pool) or the bike-minutes (mode bike).

places.description: The reach of each place, by name.

bays.description: The zone hashes of the bays within reach_m walk along the walking network.

backtest.description: The scores of the model in the backtest over the history, against climatology (B2). Empty if the backtest did not run or had no pairs.

targets.description: all, or 07:00-10:00 for target times from 07:00 to 10:00 local time.

skill_low.description: The 2.5% point of the skill in a bootstrap over days of the origin.

skill_high.description: The 97.5% point of the skill in a bootstrap over days of the origin.

zone_hash.description: The blake3 hash, in hexadecimal, of the GeoJSON feature of the zone, as the collector computes it.

rates.description: Rates of the form factor[bay] * profile[bin]. The factor of a bay is (events + strength) / (expected + strength). In mode bike, the departure factor of a reach is the sum of the events plus n times strength, over the sum of the expected events plus n times strength, for the n bays of the reach. A bay that is not in bays has the factor 1.

profile.description: The rate of all bays in each of the 48 time bins, per minute of exposure.

strength.description: The shape and rate of the gamma prior of the factors, which has mean 1.

bays.description: The events of each bay in the history, and the events that the profile gives for its exposure, by zone hash.
